## Task-1

for(i in 1:3){
print(mtcars$mpg[i])

```{r}
count_above <- function(x, c){ # creates count_above as a function, sets x as the vector and c as the cutoff
  count <- 0 # sets the count to 0
for(i in 1:length(x)){ # for i is from 1 to the length of x
  if(i > c){ # if 
    count <- count + 1 #adds +1 to the counter
  }
}
  return(count) #returns count
}
```

```{r}
count_above(iris$Sepal.Length, 6)
```
```{r}
count_above(mtcars$disp, 150)
```
